Components/Layout

App shell

The frame of an app (Mantine's AppShell): header, navbar, main, aside and footer on wide screens; on phones one column with a bottom bar. The main content scrolls, the bars stay.

One app, three widths
phone layout: app bar, content, bottom nav

      API

      <ray-app-shell> · RayAppShell

      The layout follows the shell's own width (a phone-sized frame shows the phone layout). Below breakpoint the navbar and the aside take no room (a ray-sidebar there still opens as its drawer) and the bottom slot shows. It fills the window's height (100dvh) unless sized.

      PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
      layoutlayout reflectsdefault | altdefaultdefault: the header across the top; alt: the navbar full height, the header beside it.
      breakpointbreakpointstring48emWidth (px, em or rem) below which it takes the phone layout.
      paddingpadding reflectsstringPadding of the main area: xs…xl, a number (px) or a CSS length.
      EventDescription
      ray-breakpointIt switched between the wide and the phone layout.
      SlotDescription
      (default)The main content (it scrolls).
      headerTop bar: a ray-app-bar or a header of your own.
      navbarSide navigation (a ray-sidebar). Wide screens only.
      asideA panel on the other side (details, an inspector). Wide screens only.
      footerUnder the main content.
      bottomPhones only: a ray-bottom-nav.
      PartDescription
      shellThe grid.
      headerThe header area.
      navbarThe navbar area.
      mainThe scrolling main area.
      asideThe aside area.
      footerThe footer area.
      bottomThe bottom bar area.
